rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone cannot decide and keeps delaying.

example.english: I often dither for ages over whether to buy it.
example.traditional: 我成日諗好耐都仲猶豫緊要唔要買。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 nam2 hou2 noi6 dou1 zung6 jau4 jyu6 gan2 jiu3 m4 jiu3 maai5

rows.note: Use this instead of 猶豫 when dither means physically trembling or shivering, especially from cold or fear.

example.english: I dither whenever a cold wind blows.
example.traditional: 我一吹到冷風就凍到成身發抖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ceoi1 dou3 laang5 fung1 zau6 dung3 dou3 seng4 san1 faat3 dau2

rows.jyutping: sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6 gam3 V
rows.note: Use this when someone carries out an action in a visibly flustered, nervous, or disorganized way.

example.english: When guests show up unexpectedly, I dither while making tea and even forget to add sugar.
example.traditional: 我一見到客人突然上門，就手忙腳亂咁沖茶，連糖都唔記得落。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 haak3 jan4 dat6 jin4 soeng5 mun2 zau6 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6 gam3 cung1 caa4 lin4 tong4 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 lok6
